declaration.reason: Add the owner-facing read-only recovery assessment for IRPA-ENV-2026-11501354 and enforce that queue, evidence and watermarked-preview GET requests do not mutate envelope or signing evidence. Recovery access telemetry is stored separately in recoveryAccessEvents.
declaration.expectedEffect: The affected owner can inspect recovery evidence and a watermarked non-authoritative preview. GET assessment operations preserve the entire envelope and signing evidence unchanged; access telemetry is isolated in recoveryAccessEvents. The partial-evidence amendment returns audit-chain, source-hash, stamp and finalisation-stage results independently, with a separate preview-unavailable reason.
prohibitedChanges: Do not change, reassign, delete, overwrite or recreate any existing signature, signer evidence or signing audit event.
Do not automatically retry signing, finalisation, sending, PDF generation, hashing, certificate creation or archiving.
Do not set an envelope to Completed or change any envelope status.
Do not write to or mutate any envelope, signer, field, token, hash, certificate or archive record during queue, evidence assessment or preview GET requests.
Do not change signing rules, token or link formats, sessions, signer identity, field assignment, stamping, PDF generation, hash logic, certificate logic or archive logic.
Do not change Firestore rules, secrets, environment variables, SMTP settings, deployment credentials or branch protection.
Do not modify the affected production envelope IRPA-ENV-2026-11501354.
